title: How one seed grows two different trees
summary: Follow reproducible randomness, recorded differences and hit testing through one round of a spot-the-difference game.

sections.heading: Observe first
paragraphs: On the original site, dragging turns both views together. Each pair is mostly alike, with a few small differences.

sections.heading: What the code shows
paragraphs: RNG produces random values from a seed. makeLevelOnce generates a base tree, clones it, then selects and records differences.

sections.heading: Where to start reading
paragraphs: Read the random-number helper, then follow how makeLevelOnce builds the pair and its diffs. Finally, see how tap projects difference locations to the screen and checks a click.

sections.heading: Try a small exercise
paragraphs: On the original site, compare the shared branches of a pair, rotate the view and find one difference. Then find the fields that record a difference’s position and whether it has been found.

sections.heading: Scope and limits
paragraphs: This note is based on reading a fixed source revision; we did not run the repository code. The root license is Apache-2.0; external resources such as Three.js and fonts may have separate terms.
